verdict.rationale: Mailchimp publishes documented public REST APIs. The Marketing API (root at GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/) covers creating contacts, sending campaigns and account exports, and the Transactional/Mandrill API covers sending messages, routes, dedicated IPs and allowlists, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. Its developer docs are also reachable for machine consumption via llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and no evidence on authentication or rate-limit details.
